jobs.description:
Global Crowdproject AB is seeking motivated and commercially minded consultants for assignments in capital raising, investor relations and business development.
We work with various clients and projects, helping companies establish investor relationships and raise capital to support their continued development and expansion.
A key part of the work involves identifying potential investors interested in investing in unlisted companies and becoming shareholders. Other forms of capital raising may also be included.
We are looking for independent professionals who enjoy developing business relationships and taking responsibility for their assignments from initial contact through to a completed transaction.
🌍 Work Internationally – From Anywhere in the World
You have the opportunity to carry out this assignment remotely from Sweden or other parts of the world.
Whether you already operate internationally or want to expand your professional network into new markets, this opportunity offers significant geographical flexibility.
You can develop investor relationships internationally.
Responsibilities
Identify and approach potential investors.
Build and develop long-term investor relationships.
Present our clients' businesses and projects using approved information materials.
Schedule and conduct meetings with potential investors.
Follow up with investor contacts and business opportunities.
Coordinate the investment process from initial contact through to a completed transaction, within the scope of the assignment.
Work with your own business contacts and investor leads that may be assigned through Global Crowdproject AB.

Who We Are Looking For
Experience in sales, business development, finance or investor relations.
Self-motivated, responsible and results-oriented.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable working independently with commission-based compensation.

An established business or investor network is an advantage.
Able to communicate professionally in Swedish or English.

Consulting Assignment and Compensation
This is an independent consulting assignment, not a traditional employment position.
You will enter into a consulting agreement with Global Crowdproject AB and independently carry out assignments provided through us.
Compensation is 100% commission-based. No fixed salary, guaranteed salary or guaranteed monthly compensation is provided.
You must operate your own business and be able to issue invoices for your services.
Commission is based on approved and completed transactions in accordance with the terms of the consulting agreement.
What We Offer
Independent consulting assignments in capital raising and business development.
The opportunity to work remotely.
A high degree of flexibility and personal responsibility.
The opportunity to use and expand your professional network.
Access to relevant investor contacts when assigned within the engagement.
The potential for long-term consulting collaboration.

How to Apply
Are you interested in working as an independent consultant in capital raising?
Please submit your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience in sales, business development, finance or investor relations.
Send your application to: jobb@globalcrowdproject.se
Company: Global Crowdproject AB
Engagement Type: Independent Consulting Assignment
Workplace: Remote
Compensation: 100% Commission-Based

The opportunity 
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Quantity Surveyor to join our growing team and support both the tendering and execution phases of large-scale HVDC projects worldwide.
In this role, you will play a key part in civil works cost management, quantity estimation, and commercial support throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with Engineering, Construction & Commissioning, Supply Chain Management, Project Management, and external contractors to help deliver competitive and successful HVDC projects.
This position is based in Västerås or Ludvika, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact
Develop and manage Bills of Quantities (BoQs) and quantity take-offs for HVDC civil works throughout tendering and project execution.
Support cost estimation, benchmarking, affordability initiatives, and commercial evaluations.
Collaborate with engineering, project, and procurement teams to ensure accurate scope, quantities, and cost alignment.
Monitor project costs, variations, claims, and change orders to support effective cost control.
Support subcontractor management, contract administration, cost forecasting, and project reporting.
Perform quantity take-offs and cost analyses based on engineering deliverables, technical drawings, and digital models.
Drive continuous improvement by maintaining quantity and cost data, identifying risks, and recommending cost optimization opportunities.

Your background
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in quantity surveying, cost engineering, commercial management, civil works, or construction management.
Experience in EPC projects, energy infrastructure, substations, HVDC, power plants, or industrial construction is an advantage.
Strong understanding of BoQ preparation, quantity take-offs, cost control, and contract administration.
Familiarity with recognized measurement and cost estimation standards such as CESMM, NRM2, POM(I), or other international methods of measurement for civil and infrastructure works.
Experience working with international contractors and multidisciplinary teams.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Knowledge of German and/or French is considered a merit.

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working hours
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various training and education supporting employee development
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Designer – AI-First to Objektvision
jobs.employer_name: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
jobs.description:
Objektvision is rebuilding its platform from scratch and is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape it. If you'd rather ship real UI in Claude Code than polish screens in Figma, this could be your next step.
The role
You'll be part of the team building our new customer platform: the tool property owners, managers and brokers log into to list, manage and rent out their space. That covers the obvious parts, like making it effortless to publish a listing, and the less obvious ones: access levels, billing and invoicing, and the view our customer service team works in every day. You need to understand the system behind the screens, not just the screens. 
The Product Manager prototypes ideas and tests them with customers. Once we decide to go for something, you take over: you design the interaction and UI and build the frontend yourself in Claude Code, so it's close to ready when the Full-stack Engineer picks it up. You'll design AI-powered features like listing quality scoring and matching together with our Data & AI Lead, and help build one shared design system for all markets. 
You work daily with a Product Manager and a Full-stack Engineer, and you'll have another Product Designer in the company to exchange ideas and feedback with. 
About you

5+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped products. A background in development before moving into design is a big plus

Hands-on with Claude Code (or similar) for prototyping and real frontend work

Comfortable in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React (or similar)

Pragmatic and quick to move; you know when something is good enough to ship, and you enjoy finding the best solution together with the team

Fluent in English; working/conversational Swedish required (team language is English, but daily life at the office is in Swedish)

Nice to have: experience designing AI features (chat, agents, recommendations), owning a design system, or a marketplace/proptech background 

About Objektvision
Objektvision is Sweden's leading marketplace for commercial real estate, part of Finland's Alma Media. They're rebuilding their entire platform from the ground up, going AI-first and shared across markets. Being a small company means they can actually change how they work, not just talk about it. You'll be based centrally in Stockholm, in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with flexibility to work from home the rest of the week. The culture is close-knit and generous - shared lunches, regular offsites, and a wellness allowance, with occasional trips to the team in Finland. 
Application
We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible. Objektvision is collaborating with Ants for this recruitment. Questions about the role? Reach out to Julia Lagerblad at Ants: julia.lagerblad@ants.se

In this role you will work directly with cross-functional team members to ensure that our solutions are delivered and executed in alignment with the overall delivery project priorities.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead product development efforts utilizing a multitude of processes and tools. Accountable for timely delivery, technical excellence, and process effectiveness of product development activities. Owning, planning, and maintaining the projects.
Proactively coordinate with cross discipline team members to make sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
Submit project deliverables and ensure that they adhere to quality standards.
Prepare status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
Establish effective project communication plans and ensure their execution as well as facilitate change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts on schedule and budget.
Coordinate the development of documents needed to enable successful implementation and turnover of the process or system to the design and manufacturing.
Conduct post project evaluation and identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.
Analyze project data and produce insights to optimize performance.

Your background
You hold a university degree in a relevant area, such as project management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or similar.
Experience with project management tools and models such as Gate.
Line or project management skills are desired and experience with HVDC and FACTS applications is an advantage.

You communicate well, have a structured way of working and have a strong will to drive and implement improvements and change transformations.
Most important for this role is your personality and your willingness to learn and explore new areas. Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills are crucial to succeeding in the role.
Fluency in English, written and spoken alike, is a requirement.

For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.
Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers.
You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission.
Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.
In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization.
You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

Your future challenge
This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager.
This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

Tasks
• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.
• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.
• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.
• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.
• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.
• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.
• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

Required skills
• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.
• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.
• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.
• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).
• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

As the Technical Lead for the Backend Delivery team at Embark, you will work in the shared tech organization and lead the technical execution of reliability and developer experience. Backend Delivery is a platform team that serves other shared tech functions by building self-serve infrastructure, tooling, and managing our shared multi-tenant clusters. Some examples of things we’re working on include CI/CD, observability, mesh networking, build pipelines, etc. Some of the technologies we use to make all of those are Go, Python, GCP, Bazel, Terraform, Kubernetes, Istio.
You will mentor and guide engineers, collaborate closely with design and product, and make architectural decisions regarding the infrastructure and backend development platform.
In your day to day you work as an amplifier for cross team communication & collaboration.
 Example of responsibilities: Leadership & Collaboration

Managerial responsibilities (not limited to) hiring & onboarding of new employees and long-term career development.

Serve the know-how & share best practices: coaching people to make the right decisions across dependencies and to raise concerns and needs.

Collaborate with backend services teams, the game server infrastructure team and other users of the common development platform such as data analytics and anti-cheat to define, scope, and deliver new features and improvements.

Planning and working for sustainability / scalability of team and throughput, including headcount planning and scoping.

Example of responsibilities: Architecture & Development

Support the design and evolution of robust, scalable systems within backend engineering teams in the organization (e.g. player-progression, matchmaking, etc…)

Ensure high performance and reliability by improving monitoring of our fleets

Foster best practices in code quality, automated testing, performance profiling, and release reliability.

Lower cognitive load by building tools and automation to make development iterations simpler and faster.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

A solid and proven background from software engineering and architectural leadership with previous experience developing large scale systems.

Experience from a high-paced engineering organization working with CI, scalability, and automation, etc.

Experience in working with a diverse set of partners and helping them understand the trade-offs to different product and technical decisions.

Learning, collaborative and sharing approach as well as motivation to take initiative and drive

The ability to be a great team player with good communication skills

Proven leadership qualities, including splendid recommendation stats from former team members

Professional English communication skills.

 
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

The key responsibility of the Quality Control technician is for  receiving  and analyzing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Research & Development, Testing & Validation, and Production using a range of instruments as well as participating in problem solving and technical troubleshooting exercises on the execution side.   
Key Responsibilities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Execute work instructions and participate in laboratory functions/tasks/work.   
Follow 5S and safety protocols within the production and laboratory work environment.  
Conduct analysis on a wide range of instruments and report data/results for a diverse set of samples in the expected template and/or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); and maintain control charts.  
Able to understand and execute testing and validation plans for incoming parts, product intermediates, finalized products, and other material accordingly. 
Identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Be able to troubleshoot basic to advance problems; utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Understand the fundamental principles of method development and/or method validation and able to participate in the execution.   
Able to write support documentation for standard operations.  
Maintaining instruments and measurement areas to a high standard, involving responsibility to ensure that the laboratory or production room(s)/area(s) comply with safety related guidelines, 5S guidelines, maintaining consumable inventory and instrument readiness.  
Able to train and qualifying personnel according to a skill and competence level.  
Strict adherence to Quality Assurance and Quality Control Principles.   
Participate in improvement plans and investigations for various topics.   

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor´s degree or master’s degree in a technical field is preferred.  
2 years experience in quality control from relevant industry is preferred.  
Specific knowledge in any relevant instrumentation, measurement system, or scientific field used by the company. (preferred)  
Familiar with quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, Total Quality Management (TQM). 
Familiar with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. (Preferred)  
Curious, technically educated and preferably with a strong business background.  
Experience in Cell Manufacturing, or Test and Validation is an advantage.  

 Specific skills & Knowledge 
Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.

jobs.occupation: Electrical Engineer – Cable Harness Routing Designer
jobs.description:
Join our team and help shape the future of sustainable transport solutions. We are seeking an Electrical Engineer with experience in cable harness routing design to support the development of new vehicle platforms and products. In this role, you will design and optimize cable harness routing solutions that meet functional, manufacturing, serviceability, quality, and cost requirements while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development process.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop cable harness routing solutions in 3D CAD according to technical requirements and design standards.

Create, maintain, and release routing models and associated engineering documentation.

Optimize harness installations for packaging, manufacturability, serviceability, robustness, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate with electrical architects, mechanical designers, manufacturing engineers, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

Participate in design reviews and provide technical support during concept, development, and detailed design phases.

Support prototype builds, validation activities, engineering changes, and troubleshooting throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

Experience in cable harness routing, electrical installations, or mechanical design within product development projects.

Proficiency in 3D CAD tools, preferably CATIA V5 or CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE.

Understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles.

Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

Strong communication skills in English, with a structured, analytical, and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving.

Additional Information
Some of our clients require you to undergo and be approved according to our current security regulations. Certain positions may also require specific citizenship.
 About Astek Sweden
Astek has always been driven by a strong curiosity and a passion for technological possibilities. This fascination forms the foundation of everything we do – our commitment to innovation and product development, the long-term customer relationships we build, and the value we create in every assignment, every day. With us, you will have the opportunity to grow alongside some of the industry’s most skilled engineers and technical experts.
What We Offer
We are a company where innovation, community, and professional growth are at the core. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects in an environment where your expertise and ideas are valued. We offer:
· An inspiring workplace where technology and creativity meet. · Opportunities to collaborate with leading industry players. · Professional development and career growth. · A company culture where we support each other and have fun together! · Great benefits, including 5,000 SEK in wellness allowance.
We encourage all engineers to apply, regardless of gender, background, or life situation.
Want to Be Part of Our Team?
We warmly welcome your application!
Recruitment is ongoing, so don’t hesitate to apply. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
Recruitment Contact: Daniella Hernandez Email: daniella.hernandez@astek.net

What will you do?
As a Senior iOS Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel iOS app. The iOS team is two engineers, and you'd be the third. We're moving off legacy Objective-C toward a modern Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine stack, and shifting the architecture from VIPER to MVVM-C, all while continuously shipping product features to a global user base. You'll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our iOS platform.
Areas of ownership:

Drive the modernization from legacy Objective-C to a modern Swift + SwiftUI stack

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

Build and modernize iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Contribute to architecture decisions (VIPER to MVVM-C transition, Combine, platform improvements)

Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions

Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

Maintain and improve the overall health of the iOS platform

Requirements:

5+ years building iOS apps

Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C

Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)

Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring

Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns

Can work independently and ship without constant oversight

Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions

Work effectively with AI coding tools

Good English (we write and speak it all day)

Nice to have:

Worked on large, mature products

Mobile CI/CD, testing, and DevOps experience

Audio or telecommunications experience

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we're profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. We make it cheap and easy for migrants to call and send money home. Millions of people move countries every year, and staying connected with family shouldn't cost a fortune. That's the problem we work on, from a small, international team based in Stockholm where speed and ownership matter more than process.

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots, and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support

Equal Opportunity
We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.occupation: R&D Senior Engineer for System Design
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Join our HVDC R&D team at Hitachi Energy and help pioneer the future of energy transmission. We are now looking for a R&D Senior Engineer to contribute to the development of advanced control strategies for HVDC systems, including Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) and Line Commutated Converter (LCC) technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work in a global, collaborative environment focused on innovation and technical excellence.
In this role, you will design and optimize control algorithms for MMC- and LCC-based HVDC systems, including multiterminal HVDC (MTDC) configurations. You will also perform small-signal stability analysis, harmonic studies, and transient simulations to ensure robust and reliable system performance. A key part of your responsibilities will be to lead system-level dynamic performance evaluations and drive continuous improvements in control strategies. Additionally, you will mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, helping shape the future direction of HVDC control systems and power electronics design.
How You Will Make an Impact
Contribute to converter topology design, control and protection, and main circuit development for VSC HVDC and LCC HVDC systems.
Perform insulation coordination, steady-state and dynamic stability studies, harmonic analysis, and performances under various conditions.
Address evolving customer requirements with a strong stakeholder focus.
Uphold our core values of safety, integrity, and responsibility.
Collaborate in a supportive and agile team environment.
Take ownership of both technology and your personal development.

Your Background
PhD or MSc in Power Systems, Electrical Machines and Drives, or Power Electronics Control.
Several years of experience in HVDC or FACTS technologies.
Strong knowledge of MMC topologies and HVDC control systems.
Experience in small-signal stability analysis and transient simulations.
Skilled in simulation tools: MATLAB, PSCAD/EMTDC, EMTP-RV, and ideally Modelica, RTDS, Python, C/C++.
Open-minded, solution-oriented, and collaborative with strong organizational skills.
Proficiency in English is required

What we offer 
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us
Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you and would you like to live and work in the birthplace of the HVDC and 3-phase power systems?
